message: You know, there’s nothing quite like a surprise snowstorm to remind us how unprepared we can be. I once spent an entire afternoon trying to figure out how to make a meal out of canned beans and frozen broccoli—spoiler alert, it wasn’t pretty! If you’re like me and appreciate the comedy of not being ready, this guide might just save you some kitchen disasters and keep the winter blues at bay. Stay warm and keep that pantry stocked! ❄️
